ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high; the ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 92% dark to 8% high-intensity (white) localized pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field covering both lobes, punctuated by approximately 35-45 discrete high-contrast white circular and elliptical blobs distributed across the medial and lateral zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute narrow V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel angle of 35 degrees and a vertical depth occupying approximately 10% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; approximately 14 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 12 on the right lobe, with pixel amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep from the central peduncle attachment point towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle scars) across the ventral plane; largest clusters are located in the mid-lateral sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; a prominent diagonal mark is visible on the lower interior of the right lobe, and parallel vertical rake marks are visible on the far left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-intensity textured clusters of sessile barnacles are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, creating a jagged, irregular terminal boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform dark pigmentation of the ventral surface, excluding localized scarring, which provides a high-contrast background for identifying surface anomalies.
